fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (MU) rose over 340% in 2026 but is currently undervalued at a 13x PER, with management expecting memory market shortages in 2027–2028 to be worse than in 2026.
fields.summary_ko.1: Micron is setting price floors and ceilings through long-term supply contracts with customers, with new production facilities scheduled to come online from mid-2027.
